Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished SIX-FRAME combat VFX animation sprite sheet for a top-down dark fantasy anime game.
Subject: Two razor-thin violet-black dagger cuts crossing once into an asymmetric X, fast precise sweeping blade trails like Sung Jinwoo in Solo Leveling. Sharp tapered ends, tiny sparse violet fragments. NOT a knot, butterfly, four-leaf emblem, portal or swirling ring. Directional cutting energy aimed to screen RIGHT.
EXACT LAYOUT: three equal SQUARE columns by two equal SQUARE rows, SIX frames, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. All six cells have identical dimensions and shared origin exactly at each cell center. No visible grid, borders, text or labels. Each isolated effect remains within its cell with at least 12% outer padding. Consistent camera and energy palette.
Real animation with changing structure, NOT six copies resized: frame 1 tiny ignition/leading edge (20% strength); frame 2 advancing energy opening (55% strength); frame 3 near-contact fully developed shape (90% strength); frame 4 strongest contact/pressure peak (100% strength); frame 5 energy breaks into distinct trailing fragments (60% strength); frame 6 a few dissipating wisps/embers (15% strength). The luminous structure grows, moves and breaks up smoothly with continuity. Keep every stage centered and retain the intended forward axis for directional effects.
Clean readable silhouettes and restrained particles, convincing anime sakuga combat VFX at 100-300 gameplay pixels, cinematic painted energy texture, sharp white-hot cores, no heavy outlines and no symbolic graphic emblems.
Background: perfectly uniform solid chroma green #00FF00 in every empty pixel, including cell gaps. No green inside the effect. No background lighting, floor, gradient, scenery, shadow, text, watermark, UI or character. Use identical effect scale/pivot across cells; do not independently fill each cell with its stage. Entire sheet aspect ratio 3:2.
